brief:
Jerusalem Electricity Company issued detailed guidance on the optimal use of air-conditioning and cooling devices to reduce power consumption, according to Maan Wire. The utility provided customers with practical recommendations aimed at lowering electricity usage during peak cooling seasons, when demand typically surges across the city's grid.

The company's efficiency tips address conservation measures for both household and commercial cooling systems. Officials said the guidance forms part of broader efforts to manage overall grid demand while helping consumers control their utility bills during periods of intense heat.
title: Jerusalem Electricity Company offers air-conditioning efficiency tips
